title: eCommerce Account Manager
description:
Role: eCommerce Account Manager (FMCG)

Salary: 35-55k, d.o.e

Location: Manchester city centre

We are partnering with a well established FMCG organisation to appoint an eCommerce Account Manager to help accelerate performance across online retail channels. This role will sit within the commercial function and will be responsible for unlocking growth through strong retailer partnerships, effective online execution, and continuous optimisation of the digital shelf.

The successful candidate will take a hands-on approach to managing online accounts, balancing strategic planning with day-to-day trading activity. You will play a key role in shaping how the brand shows up online, using insight, data and collaboration to drive commercially sustainable results.

The Role
- Own the commercial performance of selected online retail partners, with accountability for sales delivery and margin outcomes
- Build and maintain effective trading relationships, influencing plans and priorities across digital platforms
- Translate commercial objectives into clear online activation plans and ensure they are delivered at pace
- Identify opportunities to improve visibility, conversion and shopper experience across retailer websites
- Use performance data to diagnose issues, track progress and inform future actions
- Act as the central link between sales, marketing and supply chain to ensure joined-up execution

What You'll Bring
- Proven experience working in eCommerce, online sales or FMCG account management
- A solid understanding of how online retailers operate and how shoppers behave in digital environments
- Confidence working with data, drawing insight from performance metrics and making informed recommendations
- A structured, organised approach with the ability to juggle multiple priorities
- Strong communication skills and the credibility to influence both internal teams and external partners

Personal Attributes
- Commercially minded, with a clear focus on value creation and growth
- Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, evolving environment
- Proactive and accountable, with a strong bias toward action
- Collaborative in style, with the ability to work effectively across functions
- Curious, adaptable and motivated to continually improve performance

This opportunity offers meaningful ownership, exposure to senior stakeholders, and the chance to shape how a consumer brand performs in the online channel within a competitive FMCG landscape.

title: Senior Marketing Manager
description:
Senior Marketing Manager - Sports & Leisure Manchester or London (Hybrid) ClearCourse

Permanent role Competitive salary

Fancy leading marketing for an entire vertical, shaping strategy that spans multiple market-leading SaaS brands, and building the playbook other teams across the business will use?

ClearCourse is looking for a Senior Marketing Manager - Sports & Leisure to take the reins on marketing across our Golf SaaS brands and two Leisure SaaS brands. You'll effectively be the head of marketing for this vertical, working hand-in-hand with commercial directors to turn their targets into one coherent strategy and campaign calendar.

Requirements

What you'll be doing

This is a rare dual-mandate role - you won't just be chasing new business, you'll be protecting and growing what we've already built. With several membership-driven brands in the mix, both disciplines matter equally here:
- Own the marketing strategy and campaign calendar across the Golf and Leisure brands, translating commercial targets into a plan brand directors trust
- Drive new-business growth and demand generation, working alongside central Channel Excellence functions (PPC, SEO/GEO, Events)
- Own retention and loyalty marketing across membership-driven brands - a genuine, equally-weighted priority alongside growth
- Build group-wide blueprints for lifecycle, retention and loyalty marketing that other verticals across the business can adopt
- Partner with product teams on positioning, messaging and launches, making sure go-to-market plans land commercially
- Champion Adobe stack adoption (AEM, AJO, CJA) across your brands, working with MarTech colleagues to flag gaps and push for what's needed
- Manage and develop a Marketing Executive, setting priorities and reviewing output against the strategy

What you'll bring
- B2 B SaaS marketing experience, ideally spanning membership-driven or subscription businesses
- A genuine track record in both growth/demand generation and retention/loyalty marketing - this role needs both
- Product marketing experience: positioning, messaging, and launch management
- Comfort managing multiple brand stakeholders simultaneously, at pace
- Some line management experience
- A commercial mindset - you translate targets into plans people trust, and you're just as focused on keeping customers as winning them

Bonus points if you've got:
- AJO and AEM experience
- Golf sector experience

Benefits

Why ClearCourse

Because leading marketing for a growing vertical should come with real rewards. Here's what's in it for you:
- Competitive salary
- 25 days holiday, plus bank holidays and your birthday off
- Hybrid and flexible working options
- Private medical cover
- Health cash plan
- Life assurance
- Access to the Calm wellbeing app
- Perkbox employee benefits platform
- Enhanced parental leave
- Cycle to work scheme
- Volunteering days
- Employee Assistance Programme
- Ongoing learning, development, and career progression across the ClearCourse Group

Ready to lead the vertical?

If you're commercially sharp, dual-minded across growth and retention, and ready to build something other teams will want to copy, we want to hear from you.

Apply now and help shape the future of marketing at ClearCourse.

title: Ecommerce Executive
description:
Ecommerce Executive Online Retailer Greater Manchester Salary up to 33k

A fast-growing scale-up business is looking for an ambitious Ecommerce Executive to join its growing Sales & Marketing team. This is an opportunity for someone who is commercially curious, highly proactive and genuinely interested in how ecommerce can drive business growth.

The role is hands-on and detail focused, with responsibility across website merchandising, campaign execution, digital marketing and performance analysis. The business is looking for someone who wants to get stuck in, spot opportunities, solve problems and learn quickly in an environment where no two days are the same.

This could suit an early-career ecommerce or marketing professional with 1-3 years' experience, or an ambitious graduate with a relevant degree and a genuine passion for ecommerce and digital marketing.

The Ecommerce Executive will work closely with the Ecommerce Manager to deliver day-to-day ecommerce and digital marketing activity, ensuring campaigns are executed effectively, the website is continually optimised and performance insights are turned into action.

The role will have a strong commercial focus, with the successful individual expected to take ownership, challenge the status quo and continually look for ways to improve the customer journey and online performance.

Key Responsibilities
- Own and maintain the campaign planner, ensuring activity is accurately planned, communicated and delivered across relevant teams.
- Coordinate campaigns across email, website, homepage and social channels.
- Manage product listings and online merchandising, ensuring content is accurate, engaging and optimised for conversion.
- Support seasonal promotions, product launches and other key commercial campaigns.
- Work with creative and content teams to deliver effective website and marketing assets.
- Analyse campaign, website and customer performance, tracking key metrics including traffic, conversion, ROI, engagement and retention.
- Produce regular performance reporting and turn data into clear, actionable recommendations.
- Research competitor activity, market trends and customer behaviour to identify new opportunities for growth.
- Support CRM, email and customer loyalty initiatives, with a focus on increasing engagement and lifetime value.
- Work closely with Ecommerce, Buying, Customer Service, IT and Development teams to resolve issues and improve the customer experience.
- Manage relationships with relevant technology and service partners, including search, reviews, payments and customer support platforms.
- Identify opportunities to improve website performance, merchandising and the overall customer journey.
- Take ownership of projects and processes, documenting best practice and continually looking for more efficient ways of working.

What We're Looking For

The ideal Ecommerce Executive will be someone who combines commercial curiosity with exceptional attention to detail. Experience is important, but attitude, potential and a genuine desire to learn will be equally valued.

You will bring:
- Experience in ecommerce, digital marketing, online retail or a related discipline, or a relevant degree with strong evidence of interest in ecommerce.
- A proactive, self-motivated approach and the confidence to take ownership rather than wait to be asked.
- Strong analytical skills and the ability to understand data, identify insights and turn them into action.
- Excellent organisation and the ability to manage multiple campaigns, projects and priorities.
- A genuine interest in ecommerce, customer experience and digital growth.
- A meticulous eye for detail, particularly when managing website content, campaigns and reporting.
- A collaborative approach and the confidence to work across different teams.
- Adaptability and a willingness to get involved across different areas of the business.
- A growth mindset and enthusiasm for learning new platforms, tools and ways of working.
- Strong commercial awareness and a desire to understand what drives revenue and customer value
- Experience with ecommerce platforms such as Magento or Shopify, CRM, SEO/SEM, A/B testing, analytics or digital marketing tools would be advantageous, but is not essential.

The Ecommerce Executive role is particularly suited to someone who is hungry to learn, commercially minded and comfortable working at pace. The successful individual will be someone who sees a problem and finds a solution, spots an opportunity and acts on it, and wants to build a career in ecommerce rather than simply do a job.
